title: Ali Ali haye Ali
body:
Haye Ali Haye Ali Ya Ali Haye Ali
Gul dasta e azan say mua'zzin ne di sada
Qayam hui namaz uthey shahe lafata
Baad e ruku sajda e khalik Mai sir rakha
Sajde say sir uthate he haye Ghazab hua
Aayi nida e ghaib ke Haider hue shaheed
Gharme khuda ke saqiy e Kausar hue shaheed
Ali Ali Haye Ali Aye Mere Moula
Sajde Mai Sir Zakhmi Hua Shere khuda ka
1)
Teghe bine muljim say hai zakhmi sar e Anwar
Or khoN say namaz e ke musalla bhi hua tar
Aate hai nazar khoon mai dubey hue Haider
Masjid Mai lahu behta raha shere khuda ka
2...Teghe bine muljim jo chali farq e Ali par
Is zulm say aalam mai bapa hogaya Mehshar
Marqad Mai larazne lagi khud ruhey payambar
Jibril ne bhi noha padha shere khuda ka
3...Kufey Mai khabar phaili ke Haider hui zakhmi
Mehrab Mai damad e payamber hue zakhmi
Guriya hai falak saqiye Kausar hue zakhmi
Matam hai zamane Mai bapa shere khuda ka
4...Ab aal e Mohammad ko nahi zabt ka yara
Bikhara hua masjid Mai hai quran ka para
Quraan ke maathe say rawaN khuN ka hai dhara
Shamshir say sir zakhmi hua shere khuda ka
5...Aalam Mai Numaya hai jo aasar e Qayamat
Sadat Mai kohram hai maar e gaye Hazrat
Mabud ke ghar Mai hui Bande ki shahadat
Sir sajda e khalik Mai kata shere khuda ka
6...Kufey ke yateemo ke Labo par hai ye fariyad
Ab kon ghareebo ki karega bhala imdad
Koi bhi sahara nhi hum hogaye barbad
Ghar sog mai duba hua shere khuda ka
7...Hai zainabo kulsum ke chehro pa udasi
Abbas ke Rukhsar pa hai gard e yateemi
Hasnain ki aakhon say na kyon ashk hojari
Aalam mai hai taboot utha shere khuda ka
8...Moula ka mere kya ho bayaN haal e shahadat
Is haal Mai bhi karte hai qatil ki ziyafat
Allah re ye jazba e isaaro murawwat
Hamsar koi kya hoga bhala shere khuda ka
9....Sir pit ke jo rotey hai Zehra ke dulharey
Aakash pa larza hai chamak te hue taare
Yun Haider e karra suye khuld sidhare
Mooh takti rahi aale eba shere khuda ka
10....Mazhar ye raqam noha e gham karta rahega
Akbar bhi usey shamo sahar padhta rahega
Her dour Mai apna ye Alam ucha rahega
Saya hai saro par jo sada shere khuda ka
